newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominick's rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominick's rated buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette said Monday it began coverage of Dominick's Supermarkets Inc with a buy rating and a price target of $25 to $27 a share.
-- Shares of Dominick's, the second largest food retailer in Chicago with 100 stores and annual revenues of about $2.5 billion, were up 5/8 at 22-1/2.

-- "The cornerstone of Dominick's new store growth in the future will center around its exciting 'Fresh Store' format," Donaldson, Lufkin said in a report. Fresh Stores emphasize perishable and service departments in a European "open market" atmosphere, it added.

-- Dominick's opened eight new Fresh Stores in fiscal 1996, ended October 28, and plans nine more in 1997. At the end of fiscal 1997, 37 of Dominick's 70 combination food-and-drug stores will be in the fresh format. In 1998, that number is expected to reach 47.
-- After a recent initial public offering, Dominick's results will contain goodwill and debt retirement charges.
-- DLJ said it projects earnings from operations of $0.73 a share in fiscal 1997 and $1.38 in fiscal 1998.

-- Commenting on its price target, DLJ said, "we anticipate Dominick's will become a more seasoned equity over the next year, generating an operating performance that tracks above industry-average and keeping its store openings on plan."
